players.product: Silicon carbide (SiC) substrates: conductive, semi-insulating and P-type (6/8-inch volume, 12-inch launched); also optical-grade SiC for micro-nano optics

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 report: Q3 revenue RMB 645,591,150.64, up 102.89% year over year (a record), with Q3 gross margin 27.46% and 8-inch products over 50% of revenue; Q3 net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 85,832,892.80, swinging from a loss; nine-month revenue RMB 1,559,237,697.17, up 40.22%, and nine-month net profit RMB 27,216,245.45, up 2,330.24%; Q3 R&D RMB 41,138,276.73 (6.37% of revenue).
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 revenue RMB 645,591,150.64, up 102.89%; gross margin 27.46%

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 report, the company's explanation: rising penetration of 800V high-voltage platforms in new-energy vehicles drove automotive-grade conductive substrates, high-voltage power supplies for AI servers became a core new source of demand, and PV / storage and high-power fast charging added volume; domestic and overseas demand both grew quickly; demand from new-energy vehicles, data centers, solid-state transformers and industrial power is growing, and the company is advancing its capacity build-out (construction in progress RMB 336,637,462.98 at September 30 versus RMB 128,805,758.76 at year-end; nine-month cash paid for fixed and other long-term assets RMB 641,345,190.86).
